messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Atlas team on 2026-02-11. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]

    earlier: The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team from 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]

    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-09-02, most requests to the feature-flags service at peak were identical. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- As of 2025-09-02, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- On 2025-12-31 the Atlas team noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Atlas team for Farah. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Dune team for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API gates the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team has a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- As of 2025-12-18, the Boreal team has adopted a weekly dependency update day. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-18]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays. [valid 2025-07-21 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-21]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06-2]
